'''J. Maxwell Powers''', also known as '''Maxwell Powers''' (Japanese: '''マックスウェル・パワーズ''' ''Maxwell Powers''), is an American voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Powers was born on December 27, 1983 in {{wp|Oakland}}, {{wp|California}}, {{wp|USA}} and moved to {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} where he became a voice actor. Powers joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he gained the recurring role of the [[Drone Rotom]].
